meta.title: Team — CROIX
meta.description: The CROIX leadership team: design in Milan, engineering, controls, procurement, and code compliance in Manila.

hero.title: The people behind your project.
hero.intro: Creative leadership in Europe and deep engineering capability in Asia — giving your project well-rounded support across every time zone.

bench.label: The bench
bench.intro: CROIX is deliberately small at the top and deep in the middle. The people who win the project are the people who draw it, calculate it, specify it, and stand on site at commissioning. Partner specialists are named as partners, not folded into the studio.

members.name: Jonathan “Balong” Dela Cruz
bio: Jonathan establishes the corporate strategy, international partnerships, global supplier networks, and business operations of CROIX. Trained in business since childhood and educated in architecture at the University of Santo Tomas, he brings executive experience in luminaire manufacturing, lamp distribution, and optical engineering.

From the primary engineering hub in Metro Manila, he governs turnkey project delivery and studio production for property developers, architects, and contractors worldwide. Because the studio operates independently of fixture manufacturers, he enforces unbiased procurement policies, value-engineering standards, and equipment budget controls across every engagement.

Outside the studio, he is an active member of the Philippine Native Tree Enthusiasts (PNTE), studying, conserving, and promoting native trees across the Philippines. His conservation research in forest and coastal ecosystems guides CROIX’s commitment to human visual comfort and the protection of the nocturnal environment.

members.name: Ar. Charmaine “Ming” Javier-Fornarelli
bio: Charmaine directs the global design division from Milan, serving as Principal Lighting Designer of CROIX and Founder of its Italian sister practice, LUMEA Collective. A licensed architect with a Master’s Degree in Lighting Design and LED Technology from Politecnico di Milano, she sets the studio’s creative and technical standards across historic landmarks, corporate headquarters, and luxury hospitality.

Her portfolio includes collaborations with Voltaire Light Design on the Arena di Verona, the Benetton Group Headquarters in Treviso, and Our Habitas AlUla; with In-visible lab on Hotel Aldrovandi in Rome and the Sheraton Spa in Como; and with Sergio Boccia Lighting Design on the JW Marriott in Jeju Island.

members.name: IDr. Vivian V. Gacad, PIID
bio: Vivian leads interior design, custom millwork, and turnkey fit-out execution as a partner specialist and Founder of Vivian Gacad Interior Design Services. Practicing since 2000 with a Bachelor of Arts in Interior Design from Assumption College (1997) and membership in the Philippine Institute of Interior Designers, she also owns and directs a furniture and modular cabinetry manufacturing facility employing craftsmen from Pampanga.

Her published portfolio has been featured in Real Living Magazine, Good Housekeeping, The Philippine Star, and Studio 23’s Welcome Home, alongside exhibition spaces for the Ayala Land Sonera “Living Space” Community Project and Samsung. She has directed hospitality, institutional, commercial, and luxury residential fit-outs including Bellaroca Island Resort in Marinduque, commercial holiday installations for six Ayala Malls branches, De La Salle Dasmariñas College of Engineering and Architecture, New Hatchin Grocerant, and private residences across Metro Manila.

members.name: Engr. Aldrin Fernandez
bio: Aldrin directs the studio’s control systems engineering and commissioning division, bringing over 12 years of experience in architectural lighting, façade illumination, electrical engineering, and intelligent controls. He governs system architecture, integration, and on-site commissioning across Lutron, Crestron, Philips Dynalite, DALI, DMX, iLight, and Interact Pro platforms.

His commissioned portfolio includes the Cebu–Cordova Link Expressway (CCLEX) Phase 2 façade, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, Hilton Manila, the Marriott Grand Ballroom, Shangri-La properties in Makati, EDSA, and Mactan, Conrad Hotel, Globe Telecom Headquarters, and St. Luke’s Medical Center.

members.name: Engr. Marry Grace Benigla, REE, SO2
bio: Grace prepares photometric calculations, electrical load schedules, and CAD layouts to ensure every studio deliverable passes local building code inspections. A Registered Electrical Engineer and certified Safety Officer, she graduated as an academic scholar and Dean’s Lister from Colegio de San Juan de Letran, earning Best Electrical Engineering Student and Best in Thesis.

She presented published research on solar-powered real-time monitoring systems at the 5th International Conference on Computer Applications Technology in Fukuoka, Japan, and completed training at the Parañaque Office of the Building Official reviewing electrical plans and load schedules.

widerBench.title: More than five names.
widerBench.intro: Around the leadership team sits a working bench of engineers, documentation specialists, programmers, and fabrication partners — assembled to the scope, not carried as overhead.

groups.title: Electrical & lighting engineers
groups.body: Photometric calculations, load schedules, CAD/Revit documentation, and code review. The team is trained to read plans the way a building official will.

groups.title: Controls & commissioning
groups.body: System architecture, integration, programming, nighttime aiming, and lux verification across Lutron, Crestron, Dynalite, DALI, DMX, and BACnet/IP.

groups.title: Design & fabrication partners
groups.body: LUMEA Collective in Milan, plus interior, millwork, and fabrication specialists in Manila and Pampanga for turnkey fit-out scopes.

cta.title: Put a name to the drawing.
cta.text: Tell us which discipline your project needs first — design, photometrics, controls, or a full turnkey team.
